written: before any new adapter exists and before any panel score is read
job: Given a real Task and a list of candidate Task Objects, pick one or say nothing fits. Same prompt and parser as decider.py.
arms: always none (today's behavior when no hint is given)
plain word score on the list, threshold from dev rows only
Muse Spark Open on Baseten, the live non-fine-tuned route, same prompt
new adapter chosen on dev rows

held_out_sets.panel_held: real Tasks; gold is agreement of two blind readers (Muse Wonder 1.0, another model). Both say none: none. Both name something: any name in the intersection counts. They disagree: row left out of accuracy and counted. Not in training, never training labels.
held_out_sets.held_refs: real need text naming a Task Object, name masked; gold from the record itself; subject families split before training.
held_out_sets.orchestrator_holdout: the 194 seed-pack retrieval rows, for regression only.
held_out_sets.search_held: search-eval held-out words rows, scored with its own rule. Already read by the search agent for three rounds and by the current adapter once, so not a first look.

primary: Accuracy on panel_held, paired with the current adapter: bootstrap 95% range of the paired difference, 5000 resamples, seed 11, plus exact McNemar.
promotion_gate_all_required: paired difference versus current adapter on panel_held has lower bound above 0
accuracy on panel_held is at or above plain code and at or above always none, point estimate
false picks (a pick when gold is none, or a pick neither reader named) are no more than 20% of its picks
at least 5 more correct picks than the current adapter on panel_held
orchestrator_holdout accuracy no more than 5 points below the current adapter's 170 of 194
if_gate_fails: Live stays as it is and the result is published.
variant_choice: Only on dev.jsonl and panel_dev. Held-out sets run once, on the chosen variant and the current adapter.
independence: Muse Spark 1.3 is the live auditor. No Muse Spark 1.3 verdict, audit or answer is used as a target. Muse Wonder's panel labels and another model's are evaluation only.
exclusions: Refuted ids (114), objects named ed_trial or scale-test, objects whose summary marks them invented or made up, anything with a credential shape, doc-terms.json, all audit text, search-eval judged rows, search-eval rows written by a model.
